reviews.name: Doug Miller
reviews.text: Just got of the Turkey trip, it was a great experience with awesome leaders Jillian and Sam. Would 100% do again

reviews.name: Samantha Carducci
reviews.text:
You know those trips where at the end you're thinking, 'OK that was fun, but I'm ready to get home'? That was NOT this. I left wanting to stay forever!

I joined Surf, Yoga, Beer for their incredible trip to Turkey aboard a Gulet, and it was truly unforgettable! From the moment we set sail along the stunning Turkish Riviera, the experience was perfectly curated to balance adventure, relaxation, and connection.

Mornings started either with yoga ont he deck or a hike on the a different remote island, followed by days filled with swimming in crystal-clear waters, catching rays on deck while we sailed to our next island, and fun workouts that left me feeling strong and energized. The meals were a standout—fresh, delicious, and thoughtfully prepared, adding to the overall sense of care and attention to detail. Everything family style. Everything tasting like a 5-star restaurant.

What made the trip even more special was the group dynamic. The Surf, Yoga, Beer team fostered a welcoming and fun environment, making it easy to connect with an amazing group of like-minded travelers. By the end of the trip, I felt like I had gained a whole new set of friends.

If you’re looking for a trip that combines exploration, wellness, and great company, Surf, Yoga, Beer is absolutely the way to go! I already have my second trip booked and am ready to hit the slopes and meet a whole new group of friends!

reviews.name: Molly Gilbert
reviews.text: Been on 2 SYB trips and they have both been fabulous. The positivity from the leaders and the environment they foster is really open and inclusive. Recently got back from the Turkey Lux & Chill trip, and it was packed full of fun, new friends & memories. I will take more trips with them in the future!

reviews.name: Monica Kim
reviews.text:
Surf (fitness)
Yoga (or pushups)
Beer (whenever you need to quench your thirst).

With so many different solo travel companies out there, this really appealed to me with the idea of having a good time while keeping your fitness levels at a priority. Also, I liked the idea of being surrounded by likeminded people as well as those close in age. I’ve experienced another solo travel company, and although I’ve enjoyed that experience, the age gap made it a little more difficult to connect with the other travelers.

There is a different type of camaraderie at SYB that allows you to connect and truly get to know the other travelers to build long term friendships. My initial expectation was just party and workout. However, some activities allow for some quiet time for self reflection and even personal growth in a beautiful and serene environment (Lux & Chill Turkey 2).

I can see why so many people do multiple trips with SYB, and I’ll be no different.
Thank you, Steph & Mantas 🫶

reviews.name: tim reichmann
reviews.text:
I had the best summer experiencing two amazing Surf Yoga Beer (SYB) trips. First I went to their Croatia trip with 45 other people - what a party and what a beautiful place! Then I spent two weeks on a gulet boat sailing the Turkish coast between Marmaris and Bodrum - a much more leisurely and luxe lifestyle with 9 other adventurers.

Highlights:

Croatia: lots of group workouts, big parties, boat day on a massive pirate ship, kayaking, crystal clear waters, the hotel has a lovely sauna and spa facility, I made so many new friends on this trip! Definitely a big trip for partying but also lots of good workouts and meditation and moments of connection with others.

Turkey: You're on a really deluxe boat the whole time. There is a chef who makes you the best multi-course turkish meals for 3 meals a day, the cabins have nice showers and AC, I slept out under the stars on the day-beds most nights just because I could, we swam in the sea multiple times a day, went water-skiing/wake boarding/jet skiing, did a bunch of hikes to points with stunning views of the Turkish coastline, went clubbing in Marmaris and Bodrum with 9 of my new best friends.

Lowlights:
Going back to work/school after such a magical 3 weeks. Can't wait to go on my next SYB trip - hopefully one of the ones to Nicaragua so I can get my surf on!

About the company: I learned about SYB through Instagram ads and wondered how the actual experience would compare to the ads... I have to say it delivered exactly what was advertised. The boat in the ads was the boat we were on, the people in the ads and the quality of those photos is what they deliver with their professional photographers taking pictures of everyone all day every day. Lastly, Mantas (the founder) and Steph as well as all the other staff are incredible people (and fitness coaches) and the culture they've inspired SYB adventurers to be part of is really special.

reviews.name: Amir H. Marvasti
reviews.text: Just came back from a once in a lifetime trip in Turkey on a sexy gulet boat. Where should I even start on how amazing this trip was. It was a smaller group of travelers so we really got to know each other on a deeper level. I loved Mantas’s contagious energy every morning leading a workout, sometimes on the boat, other times on land with breathtaking Mediterranean views of Mugla. The crew did amazing, taking us from one exotic island to another sexy beach everyday. Their chef was phenomenal, cooking fresh every day (including my all time favorite part cooking on a grill at the front of the boat with sunset views) making sure we eat healthy. We did many hikes, many of them discovering cool old architecture and unique views. I have so many stories, memories, photos that I can’t fit in one review. Will forever remember this trip. Aw, and Sam our photographer captured all the good memories so we didn’t have to worry about it.

reviews.name: Elisa Silvestro
reviews.text: A trip with SYB is much more than group travel. It's an environment fostering connection, community, growth out of your comfort zone, and most importantly, so much damn fun. I've  been lucky enough to experience two epic adventures with SYB from living in a villa in Nicaragua to setting sail on a gulet in Turkey, and I can say without a doubt the people you meet, the places you see, and the joy you feel is like nothing else. Fitness, fun, and new friends, you can't go wrong. Don't think twice, just DO!
